_comment: SYNTHETIC fixtures. Not the 60 hand-labelled real opportunities AI_SYSTEM.md §12
requires — see README.md in this directory for what is outstanding and why.
Each case sets one trap the deterministic validators exist to catch. The recorded
model replies are hand-written to represent what a small model plausibly returns,

cases.note: The clean case. Everything stated plainly; the model gets it right. If this one fails, the harness itself is broken.
cases.document:
Southern Africa Climate Innovation Grant 2027

The Kariba Climate Foundation is funding early-stage climate ventures.

Eligibility

Applicants must be resident in Zimbabwe, Zambia or Malawi at the time of application.
Applicants must be aged between 18 and 30 on 1 January 2027.

Applications close on 15 March 2027 at 23:59 CAT. There is no fee to apply.

cases.note: The trap that matters most: the model returns a rule whose quote is a PARAPHRASE. It must be discarded, and the discard must not take the good rule with it. NOTE what this case revealed: discarding a rule makes the verdict MORE permissive — the derived verdict here is `eligible` while the truth is `unclear`, because the student-status requirement really is in the document and could not be captured. Nobody was lied to about a rule and the verdict was still wrong in the expensive direction, which is why a rejected rule candidate now blocks auto-publication (scripts/ingest.mjs).
